# JRailPass

> > Official Japan Rail Pass retailer offering unlimited train travel across Japan's JR network, including Shinkansen bullet trains, regional passes, and travel connectivity solutions.

JRailPass.com sells Japan Rail Pass (7, 14, 21-day options), regional tourist passes for areas like Takayama-Hokuriku and Sanyo-San'in, plus Pocket WiFi, eSIM, and Data SIM cards for travelers. The site provides comprehensive guides on pass eligibility, activation at exchange offices, and using JR trains from major airports.

## Key Topics

- Japan Rail Pass
- JR Pass
- Shinkansen bullet trains
- Regional rail passes
- Unlimited train travel
- Exchange Order and activation
- Green Pass (first class)
- Tokaido and Sanyo Shinkansen lines
- Child discount eligibility
- Pocket WiFi and eSIM
- Temporary visitor visa
- Narita and Haneda airports
- Major cities: Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, Hiroshima
- JR Pass exchange offices
- Nozomi and Mizuho trains

## Japan Rail Pass Overview

- [Japan Rail Pass - Buy Now & Travel Japan by Train](https://www.jrailpass.com): Homepage for Japan Rail Pass - 7, 14, 21 day passes with unlimited train travel
- [Japan Rail Green Pass: First Class Ticket](https://www.jrailpass.com/green-pass): First class JR Green Pass for premium Shinkansen and train travel in Japan
- [Japan Rail Pass Eligibility: Who Can Buy](https://www.jrailpass.com/eligibility): Eligibility rules for non-Japanese nationals and temporary visitor visa holders
- [How to Buy the Japan Rail Pass - Activation Process](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/where-how-to-buy-japan-rail-pass): Step-by-step guide to purchasing and exchanging JR Pass voucher in Japan
- [Japan Rail Pass Exchange Offices - Where to Activate](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/japan-rail-pass-exchange-offices): JR office locations at Narita, Haneda airports for pass activation

## Regional Tourist Passes

- [Takayama-Hokuriku Area Tourist Pass](https://www.jrailpass.com/regional-passes/takayama-hokuriku-area-pass): Regional pass for unlimited travel in Osaka, Kyoto, Kanazawa, Toyama areas
- [Sanyo-San'in Northern Kyushu Pass](https://www.jrailpass.com/regional-passes/sanyo-sanin-northern-kyushu-pass): Regional pass for unlimited rail travel in Fukuoka, Nagasaki, Kyushu region
- [Setouchi Area Pass: Buy now and travel by train](https://www.jrailpass.com/regional-passes/setouchi-area-pass): Regional pass for Seto Inland Sea rail, ferry, bus travel across 3 islands

## Travel Resources & Maps

- [Japan Rail Pass Map & Metro Maps](https://www.jrailpass.com/maps): Railway maps for Japan, Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto metro and Shinkansen routes
- [Can I use the Japan Rail Pass from the airport?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/airport-transfer): Using JR Pass from Narita, Haneda, Kansai airports with Narita Express
- [Are Nozomi and Mizuho Shinkansen covered by the JR Pass?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/nozomi-mizuho-shinkansen): Nozomi and Mizuho Shinkansen require special complementary ticket with JR Pass

## Connectivity Solutions

- [Get your eSIM for Japan](https://www.jrailpass.com/esim-japan): Virtual eSIM for Japan with 4G data, compatible with Android/iOS devices
- [How do I activate the Data SIM card?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/sim-card-activation): APN configuration instructions for activating Data SIM on Android/iOS devices
- [How long does the Pocket WiFi battery last?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/pocket-wifi-battery): Pocket WiFi battery lasts up to 9 hours on 4G network connection
- [How do I return the Pocket Wi-Fi device?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/pocket-wifi-return): Instructions for returning Pocket WiFi device via envelope before leaving Japan

## Pricing & Discounts

- [Is there a child discount for the JR Pass?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/children-discount): Children under 6 travel free on JR trains; discount pricing for ages 6-11
- [Children Discount and Eligibility - Turning 12 in Japan](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/children-eligibility): Age 11 at purchase qualifies for child Japan Rail Pass discount rate

## Pass Management & Support

- [Can I change the days I want to use the Japan Rail Pass?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/japan-rail-pass-days-change): Policy on changing Japan Rail Pass activation dates after exchange
- [Can I have my JR Pass sent to Japan?](https://www.jrailpass.com/faq/delivery-in-japan): JR Pass delivery options to Japan addresses and hotels during checkout

## Optional

- [Japan Rail Pass Refund Policy](https://www.jrailpass.com/refund-policy): Return and exchange policy for Japan Rail Pass, Pocket WiFi, SIM cards
